newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Senate elections -- results at 1505 GMT.
newsitem.headline: Czech Senate elections -- results at 1505 GMT.

text.p: The following are results after the second round run-off in elections to the new Czech Senate on Friday and Saturday with nine constituencies declared.
These figures, from the Central Election Commission (UVK) and the Czech news agency CTK, are provisional until confirmed later in the week. The parties listed are:
KDU-CSL: Christian Democratic Union-Czechoslovak People's Party
KSCM: Communist Party of Bohemia and Moravia
The run-offs are in 77 of the Senate's 81 constituencies where no one won more than half the vote in the first round. They are between the first round winner and runner-up.
